Name: powershell.exe
CommandLine: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -match '(?i)\b(codex|aider|claude)\b' -and $_.CommandLine -match '(?i)keyboard-manager-clean|uaos-program-execution|uaos-program-tree' } | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CommandLine | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4"
